lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The last hunter runs for the trees and does not come back. Smoke drifts over {village}.

lines.speaker: mc
lines.text: It's over. Let me see the wound.

lines.speaker: stranger
lines.text: Leave it. It was over before I reached your gate.

lines.speaker: stranger
lines.text: Six days I carried this sword with a hole in my side. It wanted to come here. I never asked why.

lines.speaker: stranger
lines.text: No one you need to know. Listen instead.

lines.speaker: stranger
lines.text: {emperor} will send more. He wants this blade, and the nine others like it.

lines.speaker: stranger
lines.text: Do not let him have it. Whatever it tells you, do not let him have it.

lines.speaker: stranger
lines.text: North, then. And trust no one who asks to hold it.

lines.speaker: stranger
lines.text: Good. Promises are heavy. I made too many of them.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Her breathing slows, then stops. Her fingers loosen on the hilt.
